hero.title: Ten lanes of *axe throwing*
hero.lede: Woodchuckers is a 10-lane axe throwing facility in The Alley in downtown Aiken. Call 803-500-AXES to plan your throw.

items.title: 803-500-AXES
items.text: Easy to remember, easy to call.

sections.title: Bring the crew
sections.text: Call 803-500-AXES to plan a night at the lanes.

before: The business's web address now shows a GoDaddy parked-domain page instead of Woodchuckers
Anyone searching finds no lanes, prices or booking details from the business itself
The words on this concept come from the Visit Aiken listing; prices, hours, booking and safety rules would come from the owner
after: A working page, today: phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call (803-500-AXES) and directions on a phone
HTTPS that renews itself, with nothing to patch or let lapse
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for lane booking, prices, group packages and safety rules once the owner supplies them
